time_base: Times are relative to incision (opstart) on the day of surgery. VitalDB has no real dates, so none are used here.

encounter.detail: TIVA with propofol and remifentanil target-controlled infusion (Orchestra PPF20 / RFTN20 tracks present)

encounter.value: Urgent; admitted via emergency department 16 h before incision with 2 days of right upper quadrant pain and fever

history.detail: Diagnosed about 6 years ago; on oral anticoagulation (meds-01)
Two episodes in the past year; gallstones on ultrasound

history.condition: Prior surgery: open right inguinal hernia repair
history.detail: About 12 years ago under general anaesthesia; no anaesthetic problems recorded

medications.last_dose: Evening before admission, about 19 h before incision; held since admission
Morning of surgery, about 5 h before incision (taken on the ward before the hold instruction was charted)

notes.text: 74-year-old man admitted with acute cholecystitis (enc-02) for urgent laparoscopic cholecystectomy (enc-01). Paroxysmal AF on apixaban; last dose about 19 h before planned incision (meds-01). Hypertension on losartan, taken this morning (meds-02). Pre-op Hb 11.2 g/dL (lab-01), creatinine 1.11 mg/dL (lab-02); anti-Xa level not sent (lab-06); type and screen done (lab-07). Timing of last anticoagulant dose noted and discussed with the attending surgeon; decision to proceed documented.

ASA 3 (enc-03). General anaesthesia with propofol and remifentanil TCI planned (enc-04); left radial arterial line (enc-05). Losartan taken this morning (meds-02). Codeine intolerance (alg-01). Prior general anaesthesia without problems (hx-05).
